snippet.title: World of Clashes — Official Launch Trailer | Pixel Desert MMORPG
snippet.description:
Ranked 1v1 duels. A living Najd desert. Out now on iOS — free.

World of Clashes is a pixel-art desert MMORPG built around ranked 1v1 mirror duels — mage vs mage, warrior vs warrior. The arena normalizes gear, so every match is decided by skill, not by spending.

Everything after the opening is ACTUAL GAMEPLAY, captured in-game: leveling, gearing, quests, camel mounts, dungeons, duels, open-world PvP and the ranked arena.

⚔️ WHAT'S IN THE GAME
• Two ranked duel ladders — Open and Mirror
• 138 quests across a hand-built open desert
• Six ability slots per class, each offering two builds to choose from
• Rideable camel mounts
• Kahf Al-Arwah — an endless cave that carves a new maze every run
• Snow "Frostring" free-for-all arenas
• Open-world faction PvP across two realms
• Hero-to-hero mail, guilds, feats, titles and a live auction house
• Full Arabic and English support
• A real-clock day/night cycle on Saudi time

📱 DOWNLOAD FREE
iOS — https://apps.apple.com/app/id6788747332
Android — coming soon

🔗 LINKS
Website — https://worldofclashes.com
Wiki — https://worldofclashes.com/wiki.html
Forums — https://worldofclashes.com/forums/
Discord — https://discord.gg/Psmy3m4eXD

Free to play, with cosmetic-only purchases — no pay-to-win.
Built by a solo developer in Saudi Arabia.
